definitions.explanation: The state of being widely known and admired.

examples.japanese: {世界的|せかいてき}な{名声|めいせい}がある。
{名声|めいせい}に{傷|きず}がつく。

notes:
{名声|めいせい} refers to public fame or renown, typically positive and based on achievement.

WORD FORMATION:
{名|めい} (name) + {声|せい} (voice/reputation) - literally "one's name being spoken."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {名声|めいせい}を{得|え}る: to gain fame
- {名声|めいせい}を{博|はく}す: to win widespread fame
- {名声|めいせい}が{高|たか}い: highly renowned
- {名声|めいせい}に{傷|きず}がつく: to damage one's reputation
- {世界的|せかいてき}な{名声|めいせい}: worldwide fame

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {評判|ひょうばん}: reputation (general, can be good or bad)
- {名誉|めいよ}: honor, distinction
- {有名|ゆうめい}: famous (adjective)
- {知名度|ちめいど}: name recognition, degree of fame
